title: Acoustic analysis of vowel production in adults with autism spectrum disorder: Beyond the notion of a unitary autistic voice
why_promising: Primary controlled Cypriot-Greek production from 36 adults (18 ASD, 18 neurotypical), five vowels across four stress/syllable contexts, with F0/F1/F2/F3, dynamic formant changes, duration, jitter, shimmer, HNR, intensity and vowel-space measures; methods report manual vowel segmentation in Praat.
open_question: Article states raw data will be made available by authors but no anonymous public repository/deposit was located. Locate token-level data before core ingestion.

title: SAIT-EMA: A Tridimensional Electromagnetic Articulography Database for Mandarin with Diverse Language Backgrounds
why_promising: Public CC-BY-4.0 synchronized EMA+WAV corpus with 18 speakers, multiple L1 backgrounds, nine EMA sensors, controlled vowels/syllables/sentences, rich tone/focus structure and raw articulatory trajectories.
open_question: Released phone/syllable TextGrids are MFA-generated and documentation advises users to manually verify/refine them. Determine whether a separately human-verified token/landmark layer can be isolated; never admit the unverified automatic boundaries as manual annotations.

title: EWA-DB – Early Warning of Alzheimer speech database
why_promising: Very large primary Slovak clinical-production resource: 1,649 speakers across Alzheimer/Parkinson/MCI/control groups; sustained phonation, DDK, naming and picture description; manual annotations available for most speakers plus supplied acoustic-feature JSON fields.
open_question: Files are gated by EULA and the published 'manual annotations' are primarily transcript-level. Inspect the annotation JSON after authorized access to determine whether any manually grounded segment/landmark layer supports core phonetic ingestion; keep ASR-only layers out.
